content.text:
Needed: A case with room for the board and the drives for Custom NAS from a spare desktop board
Kind of part: Any item
Top price: 250 USD

request.instructions: You plan a search of second-hand listings for one needed part or device. Write 3 to 6 search phrasings a seller might have put in a listing title: the plain name, synonyms, the part or model number in the ways it gets written, the devices it is sold for, seller wording and common misspellings; each with one line on what it finds that the others miss. A phrasing is a few words for a search box that takes words, not operators or quotes. Then one match pattern: an RE2 regular expression, applied case-insensitively to a listing's text, that a listing which fits the need matches, built from the part number with optional separators or the deciding values with their units. Keep it under 200 characters; use short gaps such as .{0,20} and classes such as [-\s]?; no lookarounds, no backreferences, no comments and no inline flags. Then the words or short phrases in a listing that rule it out: for parts, broken, not working, and any that name a variant that does not fit. Never invent a part or model number the need does not give.

content.text: {"exclusions": ["broken", "not working", "for parts", "cracked", "ITX only", "no drive bays", "missing drive cages", "2 bay", "laptop case"], "pattern": "(nas|server).{0,20}(case|chassis|enclosure)|[4-9][-\\s]?bay.{0,20}case|atx.{0,10}(tower|case)", "phrasings": [{"text": "NAS case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=NAS+case", "why": "Plain name sellers use for NAS-ready chassis with multiple drive bays."}, {"text": "server chassis", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=server+chassis", "why": "Synonym that finds rackmount and tower server cases listed as chassis not case."}, {"text": "ATX tower case with drive bays", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=ATX+tower+case+with+drive+bays", "why": "Finds spare desktop-board compatible towers with room for NAS drives."}, {"text": "8 bay computer case", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=8+bay+computer+case", "why": "Finds high drive-count towers by bay count that NAS case listings miss."}, {"text": "hot swap drive tower", "url": "https://www.ebay.com/sch/i.html?_nkw=hot+swap+drive+tower", "why": "Seller wording for NAS builds that emphasizes hot-swap cages instead of NAS."}]}
